arxiv-1807-02383.description: Abstract Natural Language Processing for Information Extraction Sonit Singh Department of Computing, Faculty of Science and Engineering, Macquarie University, Australia Abstract With rise of digital age, there is an explosion of information in the form of news, articles, social media, and so on.

arxiv-2106-08094.title: Cine-MRI detection of abdominal adhesions with spatio-temporal deep learning
arxiv-2106-08094.creator: Bram de Wilde, Richard P. G. ten Broek, Henkjan Huisman
arxiv-2106-08094.description: Abstract Adhesions are an important cause of chronic pain following abdominal surgery. Recent developments in abdominal cine-MRI have enabled the non-invasive diagnosis of adhesions. Adhesions are identified on cine-MRI by the absence of sliding motion during movement. Diagnosis and mapping of adhesions improves the management of patients with pain.

arxiv-2108-11731.title: Comparing meson-meson and diquark-antidiquark creation operators for a b ¯ ​ b ¯ ​ u ​ d \bar{b}\bar{b}ud tetraquark
arxiv-2108-11731.creator: Sebastian Velten
arxiv-2108-11731.description: Abstract We compare two frequently discussed competing structures for a stable b ¯ ​ b ¯ ​ u ​ d \bar{b}\bar{b}ud tetraquark with quantum numbers I ⁡ ( J P ) = 0 ​ ( 1 + ) I(J^{P})=0(1^{+}) by considering a meson-meson as well as a diquark-antidiquark creation operator.

arxiv-2202-07485.title: Approaching the coupon collector’s problem with group drawings via Stein’s method
arxiv-2202-07485.creator: Carina Betken, Christoph Thäle
arxiv-2202-07485.description: Abstract In this paper the coupon collector’s problem with group drawings is studied. Assume there are n n different coupons. At each time precisely s s of the n n coupons are drawn, where all choices are supposed to have equal probability.

arxiv-2206-15068.title: Accountable Private Set Cardinality for Distributed Measurement CCS: Security and privacy Cryptography CCS: Security and privacy Network security CCS: Security and privacy Security protocols Journal: TOPS Volume: 25 4 25 5 Price: 15.00 DOI: 10.1145/3477531
arxiv-2206-15068.creator: Ellis Fenske, Akshaya Mani, Aaron Johnson, Micah Sherr
arxiv-2206-15068.description: Abstract . We introduce cryptographic protocols for securely and efficiently computing the cardinality of set union and set intersection. Our private set-cardinality protocols ( PSC ) are designed for the setting in which a large set of parties in a distributed system makes observations, and a small set of parties with more resources and higher reliability aggregates the observations.

arxiv-2212-01000.title: A Dynamical Systems Analysis of the Effects of the Launch Rate Distribution on the Stability of a Source-Sink Orbital Debris Model
arxiv-2212-01000.description: Abstract Future launches are projected to significantly increase both the number of active satellites and aggregate collision risk in Low Earth Orbit (LEO). Ensuring the long-term sustainability of the space environment demands an accurate model to understand and predict the effect of launch rate distribution as a major driver of the evolution of the LEO orbital population.

arxiv-2302-04913.title: Universal approach for quantum interfaces with atomic arrays
arxiv-2302-04913.creator: Yakov Solomons, Roni Ben-Maimon, Ephraim Shahmoon
arxiv-2302-04913.description: Abstract We develop a general approach for the characterization of atom-array platforms as light-matter interfaces, focusing on their application in quantum memory and photonic entanglement generation. Our approach is based on the mapping of atom-array problems to a generic 1D model of light interacting with a collective dipole.

arxiv-2411-04943.title: Terahertz generation via all-optical quantum control in 2D and 3D materials
arxiv-2411-04943.creator: Kamalesh Jana 1, Amanda B. B. de Souza 1 , Yonghao Mi 1 , Shima Gholam-Mirzaei 1 , Dong Hyuk Ko 1 , Saroj R. Tripathi 1 , 2 {}^{1},^{2} , Shawn Sederberg 3 , James A. Gupta 4, Paul B. Corkum 1
arxiv-2411-04943.description: Abstract Using optical technology for current injection and electromagnetic emission simplifies the comparison between materials. Here, we inject current into monolayer graphene and bulk gallium arsenide (GaAs) using two-color quantum interference and detect the emitted electric field by electro-optic sampling.

arxiv-2504-05639.title: DBOT: Artificial Intelligence for Systematic Long-Term Investing
arxiv-2504-05639.creator: Vasant Dhar and João Sedoc
arxiv-2504-05639.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Vasant Dhar and João Sedoc. Long-term investing was previously seen as requiring human judgment. With the advent of generative artificial intelligence (AI) systems, automated systematic long-term investing is now feasible. In this paper, we present DBOT, a system whose goal is to reason about valuation like Aswath Damodaran, who is a unique expert in the investment arena in terms of having published thousands of valuations on companies in addition to his numerous writings on the topic, which provide ready training data for an AI

arxiv-2510-17118.title: On the Terwilliger algebras of quasi-thin Schurian association schemes Thanks: ∗ The author gratefully acknowledges that this research was supported by the Fields Institute for Research in Mathematical Sciences. a Corresponding author
arxiv-2510-17118.creator: Roghayeh Maleki, Andriaherimanana Sarobidy Razafimahatratra ∗,a
arxiv-2510-17118.description: Abstract . We give necessary and sufficient conditions for the Terwilliger algebra of a quasi-thin Schurian association scheme to coincide with: (a) the centralizer algebra of a point stabilizer of its automorphism group, and (b) its subspace T 0 T^{0} . As a by-product, a full characterization of triply-transitive quasi-thin association schemes is given.

arxiv-2510-26749.title: Tunable frequency conversion and comb generation with a superconducting artificial atom
arxiv-2510-26749.creator: Fahad Aziz, Zhengqi Niu, Tzu-Yen Hsieh, Kuan Ting Lin, Yu-Huan Huang, Yen-Hsiang Lin, Ching-Yeh Chen, Yu-Ting Cheng, Kai-Min Hsieh, Jeng-Chung Chen, Anton Frisk Kockum, Guin-Dar Lin, Zhi-Rong Lin, Ping-Yi Wen, Io-Chun Hoi
arxiv-2510-26749.description: Abstract We investigate the power spectral density emitted by a superconducting artificial atom coupled to the end of a semi-infinite transmission line and driven by two continuous radio-frequency fields. In this setup, we observe the generation of multiple frequency peaks and the formation of frequency combs with equal detuning between those peaks.

arxiv-2511-11665.title: Clifford Algebraic Rotor Embeddings : Maybe embeddings should start to CARE
arxiv-2511-11665.creator: Sameeksha Sriram, Ayush Paliwal, Alexander S. Ecker, Chase van de Geijn
arxiv-2511-11665.description: Abstract Rotary Positional Embeddings (RoPE) have demonstrated exceptional performance as a positional encoding method, consistently outperforming their baselines. While recent work has sought to extend RoPE to higher-dimensional inputs, many such extensions are non-commutative, thereby forfeiting RoPE’s shift-equivariance property. Spherical RoPE is one such non-commutative variant, motivated by the idea of rotating embedding vectors on spheres rather than circles.

arxiv-2512-17589.title: Torrent : A Distributed DMA for Efficient and Flexible Point-to-Multipoint Data Movement
arxiv-2512-17589.creator: Yunhao Deng ∗ , Fanchen Kong ∗ , Xiaoling Yi, Ryan Antonio, Marian Verhelst
arxiv-2512-17589.description: Abstract The growing disparity between computational power and on-chip communication bandwidth is a critical bottleneck in modern Systems-on-Chip (SoCs), especially for data-parallel workloads like AI. Efficient point-to-multipoint (P2MP) data movement, such as multicast, is essential for high performance. However, native multicast support is lacking in standard interconnect protocols.

britannica-1911-roscher-wilhelm-georg-fr.title: Roscher, Wilhelm Georg Friedrich (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-roscher-wilhelm-georg-fr.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-roscher-wilhelm-georg-fr.description: Article 'Roscher, Wilhelm Georg Friedrich' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 23), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. German economist, was born at Hanover on the 21st of October 1817. He studied at Göttingen and Berlin, and obtained a professorship at Göttingen in 1844 and subsequently at Leipzig in 1848. Omitting preparatory indications and undeveloped germs of doctrine, the origin of the “historical” school of political economy may be traced to Roscher.

plos-pone-0007830.creator: Massimiliano Baldassarre, Ziba Razinia, Clara F. Burande et al.
plos-pone-0007830.description: PLOS ONE research article. Mammalian filamins (FLNs) are a family of three large actin-binding proteins. FLNa, the founding member of the family, was implicated in migration by cell biological analyses and the identification of FLNA mutations in the neuronal migration disorder periventricular heterotopia.

pmc-11362488.creator: Andreas Brandl, Jan Wilke, Thomas Horstmann, Rüdiger Reer, Christoph Egner, Tobias Schmidt, Robert Schleip
pmc-11362488.description: Reduced shear strain and deformability of the thoracolumbar fascia has been linked to low back pain. A number of ultrasound examination methods have been developed for laboratory rather than clinical practice. The aim of this study was to examine the reliability and discriminative validity (patients vs.

pmc-11388800.title: Crosstalk between 6-methyladenine and 4-methylcytosine in Geobacter sulfurreducens exposed to extremely low-frequency electromagnetic field
pmc-11388800.creator: Zhenhua Shi, Yingrong Zhang, Wanqiu Chen, Zhen Yu
pmc-11388800.description: Summary4-Methylcytosine (4mC) and 6-methyladenine (6mA) are the most prevalent types of DNA modifications in prokaryotes. However, whether there is crosstalk between 4mC and 6mA remain unknown. Here, methylomes and transcriptomes of Geobacter sulfurreducens exposed to different intensities of extremely low frequency electromagnetic fields (ELF-EMF) were investigated.

pmc-11587968.title: Combined adductor canal (ACB) and sacral erector spinae plane (S-ESP) blocks for total knee arthroplasty pain in hemophilic arthropathy
pmc-11587968.creator: Francesco Marrone, Pierfrancesco Fusco, Saverio Paventi, Carmine Pullano
pmc-11587968.description: We present the case of a successful application of combined adductor canal block (ACB) and sacral erector spinae plane (S-ESP) block for the management of a patient suffering from severe hemophilia A with an end-stage arthropathy who underwent total knee replacement.

pmc-11713758.title: Subjects treated with expanded non‐genetically modified autologous Natural Killer cells (SNK01) show improved changes in CSF α‐synuclein and in cognitive function
pmc-11713758.creator: Clemente Humberto Zúñiga Gil, Blanca Isaura Acosta Gallo, Rufino Menchaca Díaz, Cesar Alejandro Amescua, Sean Hong, Lucia Hui, Hank Lee, Paul Chang, Katia Betito, Paul Y Song
pmc-11713758.description: BackgroundAccumulating evidence suggests that the presynaptic protein α‐synuclein (α‐syn), is involved in the pathophysiology of AD and elevated in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF). The role of Natural Killer (NK) cells of the innate immune system in AD has largely been overlooked. In a murine model, depletion of NK cells augmented the accumulation of pathological α‐syn.

pmc-12427504.title: Novel Strategy to Prevent Cancer Metastasis with Metastasis-Regulating miRNAs Found in Extracellular Vesicles Secreted from Stemness-High Cells
pmc-12427504.creator: Mikako Saito, Hideaki Matsuoka, Marco Falasca
pmc-12427504.description: Simple SummaryExtracellular vesicles (EVs) secreted by cancer cells were previously believed to contribute to metastasis promotion. However, recent studies have shown that EVs secreted by stemness-high cells, such as stem cells and stemness-intensified cancer cells, may exert significant suppressive effects on cancer metastasis.

pmc-12447410.title: Actionable arrhythmias in low-risk patients with ST segment elevation myocardial infarction (STEMI): role for continued telemetry beyond 24–48 h
pmc-12447410.creator: Thomas Lowe, Rama Mangipudi, Minyoung Kim, Daniel Baik, Haissam Haddad, Jay Shavadia
pmc-12447410.description: Highlights•With contemporary STEMI care, the need for prolonged telemetry for surveillance of an actionable arrhythmia is unclear.•Beyond the first 24-48 hours, the incident rate for an actionable arrhythmia is low.•Traditionally established prognostic variables in STEMI would likely guide triage for longer telemetry durations in STEMI.

pmc-13353921.description: BackgroundPrecise assessment and longitudinal monitoring of peri-implant soft tissues are essential in implant dentistry, and digital workflows may enable objective and reproducible quantification of soft-tissue dynamics.
